introduction.p: We will say that two numbers between 1 and 31 are related, written a \sim b if their difference is a multiple of 7. So for example, 3 \sim 24\text{,} since 24-3 = 3\cdot 7\text{,} but 3 \not\sim 15 since 15-3 = 12 which is not a multiple of 7.

statement.p: Which of the following are true? That is, which of the following pairs of numbers are related as we have defined above?
Which of the following statements are true about the \sim relation in this case?

li.p: a \sim a for every number a
a \not\sim a for any number a
For any numbers a and b, if a \sim b, then b \sim a
For any numbers a and b, if a \sim b and b \sim a, then a = b
For any numbers a and b, if a \sim b and b \sim c, then a \sim c

statement.p: We will write [a] for the set of all numbers related to a\text{.} For example, [7] = \{7, 14, 21, 28\}\text{.} Find each of the following:

Are there any numbers that are in more than one of the sets [a] above?
?
Yes
No
